review.method: Ordered candidate sweep of all polished turns; expanded full-turn context at selected decisions; supplementary numeric-clock/spatial sweep; focused semantic review; deterministic provenance checks.
review.limitation: Not an independent exhaustive semantic audit of every turn. Recall not measured. Source transcription uncertainty retained.

summary: A non-linear downtime session followed by a two-day festival and next-morning departure. Relative order is much stronger than civil dates.
issues: Transcript order is not chronological: initiation appears before earlier mirror conversations.
No spoken civil date independently confirms June 9 or June 20. Do not date opening initiation as June 9 simply because it appears first.
Feast of Bhishma reference note has an unresolved June 17/18 calendar conflict; its date is not used as an independent anchor.
Dream and mirror locations are retained as observations, excluded from physical travel.
